input.code:
# ==========================================================
# Prepare campaign member: validate email + status, resolve person, check campaign ID
# (merge of the "email / member status" step and the "person / campaign" step)
# ==========================================================

# ===== 1. EMAIL + MEMBER STATUS =====
email = input["email"].to_s.strip.downcase
valid = email.match?(/\A[^@\s'\\]+@[^@\s'\\]+\.[^@\s'\\]+\z/)
member_status = { "approved" => "Registered = Approved", "pending_approval" => "Registered = Pending" }[input["approval_status"].to_s.strip.downcase]
skip_reason =
  if !valid then "Invalid email: #{email}"
  elsif member_status.nil? then "Unsupported Luma approval status: #{input["approval_status"]}"
  end

# ===== 2. PERSON (Contact first, then Lead) + CAMPAIGN CHECK =====
sf_id = /\A[a-zA-Z0-9]{15}([a-zA-Z0-9]{3})?\z/
contact_id  = input["contact_id"].to_s.strip
lead_id     = input["lead_id"].to_s.strip
campaign_id = input["campaign_id"].to_s.strip
person_type, person_id =
  if contact_id.match?(sf_id) then ["Contact", contact_id]
  elsif lead_id.match?(sf_id) then ["Lead", lead_id]
  else [nil, nil]
  end
campaign_issue =
  if campaign_id.empty? then "Luma slug not found in campaign sheet: #{input["luma_url_slug"]}"
  elsif !campaign_id.match?(sf_id) then "Invalid SF campaign ID in sheet: #{campaign_id}"
  end
result_status, result_message =
  if person_id.nil? then ["Not found", ["No Salesforce Contact or Lead for this email", campaign_issue].compact.join(" | ")]
  elsif campaign_issue then ["Campaign not found", campaign_issue]
  end

{
  email: email, member_status: member_status, skip_reason: skip_reason,
  parent_type: person_type == "Contact" ? "Account" : person_type, # Account | Lead | nil
  person_id: person_id, campaign_id: campaign_id,
  contact_id: person_type == "Contact" ? person_id : nil,
  lead_id:    person_type == "Lead" ? person_id : nil,
  member_query: person_id && "CampaignId = '#{campaign_id}' AND #{person_type}Id = '#{person_id}'",
  campaign_ok: campaign_issue.nil?,
  result_status: result_status, result_message: result_message
}
